title: Don't buy... It's not the same buffet organizer
text: Don't buy... It's not the same buffet organizer. I was pissed Because it was a gift to my Mother. And it was horrible. It was not the same design on the picture on Amazon. It was wobbly and I was pissed. There was nothing to stop the stacking from moving. My mom was sad. It was embarrassing to give her this gift and it did not even come in a regular box. It just came in a cardboard box. What a waste. Then mike the collections company was very rude.

product_metadata.title: Collections Etc Buffet Organizer with Scroll Design, 7-Piece Set for Plates, Napkins and Cutlery
features: This clever organizer saves space on your buffet, can be customized to fit your needs and stores compactly when not in use
The 7-piece set can be arranged to hold dinner, salad or dessert plates, napkins and cutlery for a buffet, or use the plate stands to serve appetizers or desserts
19 1/2"L x 14"W x 15 1/2"H when stacked| Napkin holder: 7"Sq| x 4"H; four utensil holders: 2 1/2"Dia
